njdoh.caveat: All_LTC and All_Acute are different licensed universes. They are not added together and are not added to CMS. FacID is not a license number. Office/address county is not a service area.

cms.caveat: CMS overlay is statewide New Jersey geography. Exact NJDOH↔CMS CCN joins are not in this snapshot. County CMS counts are unknown, not zero. CMS directory is not an NJDOH identity join.

enforcement.caveat: Exact FacID/license county assignment is not in this snapshot. Unresolved, unsafe-rejected, and name-only matches are not county-assigned. Missing county enforcement is unknown, not a clean county. NOTICE/PENALTY/DPOC retain official action semantics.

staffing.semantics: Official values are residents per one staff member (1RN:#Res). Missing codes are not zero.
staffing.caveat: Official values are 1RN:#Res / 1LPN:#Res / 1CNA:#Res (residents per one staff member). A higher ratio means more residents per staff. Staffing is nursing-home / relevant facility only and is not copied to AL, HHA, Hospice, PACE, or CCRC. County aggregate is omitted because source-native county numerators and denominators are not in the public snapshot. Missing is not zero. No staffing score.

medicaid.caveat: Schedule rows are name/subtype/rate only. County identity coverage is incomplete, not zero. A listed rate is not Medicaid participation and is not a quality score. Name-only rows are not assigned to a county.

pace.caveat: Center address county is not a service area. Organization is not a center. Operating is not awarded. A county PACE listing is not guaranteed eligibility.

ccrc.caveat: Missing CCRC Certificate of Authority roster is unknown, not zero CCRCs. Somerset planning-inventory CCRC points are not that roster.

findings.text: NJDOH All_LTC lists 46 licensed identities in Union County as of 2026-08-31, including 19 SNF/NF and 8 ALR. All_Acute lists 74 identities, including 1 Home Health Agency offices, 4 Hospice Programs, 0 Hospice Branches, and 2 Hospice Inpatient identities. These universes are not combined into one senior-provider total. Office/address county is not a service area.

According to the county's dated program information (2026-01-14), eligible Union County residents ages 62 and over may apply for a Senior Home Improvement Grant capped at $10,000 that does not have to be repaid, subject to the same income/property guidelines as the Home Improvement Program. This is not a guarantee of eligibility or current funding beyond the source date.

Union County Division on Aging / ADRC (908-527-4870; toll-free 888-280-8226) is the county aging resource. The May 2026 resource directory PDF is cited, not copied. A county AAA directory is not a facility license.
Lutheran Senior LIFE at Union is listed as OPERATING with a Union County center address (Plainfield). Center address is not a service area. Operating is not awarded.
